title: Learning Networked Dynamical Systems via Neural ODE-based Graph Structure Inference
abstract: arXiv:2611.25586v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Inferring the latent interaction graph from multivariate time series is fundamental to understanding complex dynamical systems in neuroscience, biology, and physics. Despite recent progress in neural relational inference, most methods rely on discrete-time modeling, which degrades under sparse and irregular observations and tends to entangle multi-hop dependencies into spurious direct edges. We show that a continuous-time formulation naturally decouples inference from any fixed observation schedule, allowing gradient signals to be integrated continuously between observations for both dynamics and structure learning. We propose NOGI (Neural ODE-based Graph Inference), a framework that couples a deterministic graph learner with an MPNN-based Neural ODE. translated_title: 基于神经ODE图结构推断的网络化动力系统学习
translated_abstract: 从多变量时间序列中推断潜在交互图，对于理解神经科学、生物学和物理学中的复杂动力系统至关重要。尽管神经关系推断近来取得了进展，但大多数方法依赖于离散时间建模，这在稀疏和不规则观测下性能会下降，并且容易将多跳依赖纠缠成虚假的直接边。我们证明了连续时间公式能够自然地将推断与任何固定的观测时间表解耦，使梯度信号能够在观测间隔之间连续积分，从而同时服务于动力学学习和结构学习。我们提出了NOGI（Neural ODE-based Graph Inference，基于神经ODE的图推断）框架，该框架将确定性图学习器与基于MPNN的神经ODE相结合，两个模块通过伴随方法进行端到端训练。在两种规模下的四个模拟动力系统中，NOGI在32个评估案例中的30个中实现了最佳的结构恢复效果。
tldr: 该论文提出NOGI框架，通过将确定性图学习器与基于MPNN的神经ODE相结合并采用伴随方法端到端训练，实现了连续时间下的潜在交互图推断，在稀疏和不规则观测下显著提升了复杂动力系统的结构恢复性能。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes NOGI, a continuous-time framework coupling a deterministic graph learner with an MPNN-based Neural ODE trained end-to-end via the adjoint method, achieving state-of-the-art latent interaction graph recovery under sparse and irregular observations.
